beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Tokyo makes translation infrastructural across permission, venue, moving image, language, textile exchange, recognition and retained seasons. This chapter follows commerce: Between runway attention and an order sit identifiers, line sheets, showrooms, buyer permissions and product records whose adoption is often claimed faster than it is proved.
beats.onScreen: Then: JFWO lists Fashion Prize of Tokyo and Tokyo Fashion Award as related divisions; both maintain distinct programme surfaces.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: JFWO lists Fashion Prize of Tokyo and Tokyo Fashion Award as related divisions; both maintain distinct programme surfaces. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The current homepage publishes award announcements beside reports and programme information, making recognition part of the event’s media infrastructure.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Selection rationale, downstream commercial results and long-term support outcomes require award-level reporting; a title alone does not prove impact.
